meta.title: Standards & Compliance | Abdul Halim Vacation Homes
meta.description: How Abdul Halim Vacation Homes protects the owner's asset, reputation and regulatory standing: integrity, stewardship, accountability, regulatory compliance, guest conduct and owner reporting.

hero.title: Standards & Compliance
hero.intro: How we protect the owner's asset, reputation and regulatory standing.

items.title: Integrity
items.body: Transparent records and dealings with owners, guests and authorities.

items.title: Stewardship
items.body: Regular inspections and prompt maintenance keep each building safe and in good condition.

items.title: Accountability
items.body: Strict adherence to Department of Economy and Tourism regulations, with a partner responsible for every property.

items.title: Regulatory compliance
items.body: Each holiday-home unit operates under its own permit. Guests are registered as required, and applicable tourism fees are collected and remitted.

items.title: Guest conduct
items.body: Family-oriented occupancy, identification for every guest, no parties or events, and house rules that are enforced. This protects the property's standing in its community.

items.title: Owner reporting
items.body: Owners receive [frequency] reports covering occupancy, maintenance log and payment schedule.
